passwordHint: 15–128 characters. Spaces are allowed; a long phrase works well.

login.title: Log in
login.description: Order from your suppliers, or manage your catalogue.
login.noAccount: Accounts are created by invitation. Ask your company's owner, or the Narudžbine team to set up a new company.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your login email. If it belongs to an active account, we'll email you a link that works for 30 minutes.
forgot.sentDescription: If {email} belongs to an account, a reset link is on its way. Only the newest link works.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: After the change you'll be signed out everywhere and can log in with the new password.
reset.doneDescription: Log in with your new password.
reset.missingDescription: Open the link from your email again, or request a new one.

invitation.title: You're invited to Narudžbine
invitation.description: What is this invitation for? The email doesn't say, so pick the option that matches the person who invited you.
invitation.missingDescription: Open the invitation link from your email again.
invitation.ORGANIZATIONHint: The Narudžbine team or a vendor invited you to create your company's account.
invitation.MEMBERHint: A colleague invited you to work in your company's existing account.
invitation.TRADING: Connect my company with a vendor
invitation.TRADINGHint: Your company already uses Narudžbine and a vendor invited it to order.
invitation.proofExplain: First we confirm the invited address: we'll email a confirmation link to it. Open that link on this device within 30 minutes.
invitation.proofSentDescription: If the invitation is still valid, a confirmation link is on its way. Open it in this browser to finish.
invitation.haveProof: A confirmation link was already opened on this device.
invitation.tradingSignedOut: Log in as the owner or an admin of your company, using the invited email address. Then open the invitation link again or come back here.
invitation.tradingWrongAccount: Only the owner or an admin of a buyer company, signed in with the invited email address, can accept this.
invitation.acceptedDescription: Your company can now order from this vendor.
invitation.organizationOnWeb: Setting up a new company is done in the web app: open the invitation email on a computer and follow the link there.

setup.title: Finish your invitation
setup.missingInvitationDescription: This confirmation belongs to an invitation. Open the invitation link from your first email in this browser, then this confirmation link again.
setup.missingProofDescription: Request a confirmation link from the invitation page and open it in this browser.
setup.yourNameHint: Teammates and partners see this on orders and messages.
setup.registrationHint: Company registration number (matični broj / JIB). It can't be changed later.
setup.taxHint: Optional (PIB). It can't be changed later.
setup.countryHint: Must match the invitation. The country can never be changed.
setup.defaultLanguageHint: Default for your team's app and emails; everyone can choose their own.
setup.requestNewProof: Email me a new confirmation link
setup.proofResent: A new confirmation link is on its way.
setup.doneOrganization: {name} is set up. Log in with the invited email address and password to continue — then add your locations and invite your team.
setup.doneMember: You've joined the team. Log in with {email} and your new password.
setup.inProgress: Your setup is still being processed. Wait a moment and submit the same details again.

emailProof.title: Confirm this email address
emailProof.description: This confirms you can receive mail at this address for a pending login-email change.
emailProof.doneDescription: When both the old and the new address are confirmed, finish the change on your account's security page.
emailProof.missingDescription: Open the link from your email again.

recovery.title: Account recovery
recovery.noticeDescription: The Narudžbine team is reviewing an account recovery for your organization (reference {caseId}). If you didn't expect this, contact Narudžbine support right away.
recovery.acceptDescription: Sign in with the account being recovered, then enter the case reference the Narudžbine team gave you.
recovery.caseReferenceHint: The case ID from the Narudžbine support team.
recovery.caseInvalid: Enter the case reference exactly as you received it
recovery.signInFirst: Log in with the account being recovered to accept.
recovery.doneDescription: All sessions were signed out. Log in again to continue.
recovery.missingDescription: Open the link from your email again.
